items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Well, all those was Thomas. Joel Moreira. And Lawrence, the brother.

ctx.x: Well, all those was Thomas. Joel Moreira. And Lawrence, the brother. Guitar? Who would play guitar then?
Well, at that time it was banjo. Banjo was the thing? Banjo was the thing.
